candidate.title: Maturation of human cardiac organoids enables complex disease modeling and drug discovery.
candidate.abstract: Maturation of human pluripotent stem (hPS) cell-derived cardiomyocytes is critical for their use as a model system. Here we mimic human heart maturation pathways in the setting of hPS cell-derived cardiac organoids (hCOs). Specifically, transient activation of 5' AMP-activated protein kinase and estrogen-related receptor enhanced cardiomyocyte maturation, inducing expression of mature sarcomeric and oxidative phosphorylation proteins, and increasing metabolic capacity. hCOs generated using the directed maturation protocol (DM-hCOs) recapitulate cardiac drug responses and, when derived from calsequestrin 2 (CASQ2) and ryanodine receptor 2 (RYR2) mutant hPS cells exhibit a pro-arrhythmia phenotype. These DM-hCOs also comprise multiple cell types, which we characterize and benchmark to the human heart. Modeling of cardiomyopathy caused by a desmoplakin (DSP) mutation resulted in fibrosis and cardiac dysfunction and led to identifying the bromodomain and extra-terminal inhibitor INCB054329 as a drug mitigating the desmoplakin-related functional defect. These findings establish DM-hCOs as a versatile platform for applications in cardiac biology, disease and drug screening.

extraction.method: AMPK/ERR激动剂诱导hCO成熟并建模
extraction.data: hPS细胞来源心脏类器官，转录组/蛋白质组/功能表征
extraction.scenario: 心脏疾病建模与药物发现
extraction.benchmark: 与SF-hCO方案及起搏/代谢成熟方案对比
extraction.results: MK8722+DY131使cTnI显著升高，TNNI3比例达18%（约20周胎儿心脏），DM-hCOs可建模复杂疾病
extraction.limitations: 成年心脏特性仍未完全实现，长期电起搏有毒性
extraction.summary: 为解决hPS细胞来源心肌细胞不成熟的问题，筛选了驱动成熟的条件。发现短暂激活AMPK和ERR可诱导转录组、蛋白质组、收缩功能和代谢能力的稳健成熟。DM-hCOs可忠实建模复杂疾病并用于药物测试。
